build_dataset_aic2coco: build an Aic2CocoDataset instance from a COCO-style annotation file for pose estimation
parse_data_info_method: parse raw AIC annotation data and map keypoints from AIC to COCO keypoint order
review_AIC_TO_COCO_INDICES: review the AIC_TO_COCO_INDICES mapping that translates AIC joint indices to COCO joint indices
refactor_parse_data_info: refactor parse_data_info to support additional keypoint formats beyond AIC to COCO conversion
test_Aic2CocoDataset: test the Aic2CocoDataset class by instantiating it with an annotation file and verifying parsed data
